lines.zh: 长脸低垂，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Long face lowered, I creep forward.

lines.zh: 身体又变了，走路姿势也怪。
lines.en: Changed again, and my gait is strange.

lines.zh: 像一头爬行的兽，贴地移动。
lines.en: I move low, like a crawling beast.

lines.zh: 肩膀向前耸，整个人像矛。
lines.en: Shoulders hunched, my body like a spear.
Two steps, then I stop to listen.
My head is too big; I duck through doors.
My skull plate snaps a branch.
I walk close. That is what frightens you.

lines.zh: 手指太长，走路时垂到地。
lines.en: My fingers hang down to the ground.

lines.zh: 每一步都没有多余的声音。
lines.en: Each step makes no wasted sound.
Half a circuit of the camp.

lines.zh: 身体重心前倾，随时能扑。
lines.en: Weight forward, ready to pounce.
Standing, my head slightly tilted.

lines.zh: 这副样子，连我自己都要适应。
lines.en: Even I must get used to this face.

lines.zh: 爪子在膝前扣紧又松开。
lines.en: My claws clench and release.

lines.zh: 我听着营地里的每一句话。
lines.en: I hear every word in camp.
My long face shows nothing.

lines.zh: 呼吸缓慢，几乎看不出来。
lines.en: My breathing is slow, almost unseen.

lines.zh: 我在算，还需要几次变化。
lines.en: I am counting how many changes remain.

lines.zh: 这根手指，刚才捏碎一把剑。
lines.en: This finger just crushed a sword.
My tail coils at my legs, quiet.
I itch, and scratch my shell.

lines.zh: 低头看自己的爪，越看越满意。
lines.en: I look at my claws and like them more.

lines.zh: 站得像一座歪掉的雕像。
lines.en: I stand like a crooked statue.

lines.zh: 气在脸侧形成薄薄的光。
lines.en: A thin aura glows at my cheek.
Do not come close. I am thinking.
Look at my face. Do not turn away.
This shape frightens you.
My eyes are on you.
You stepped back. I saw.
My long face is right in front of you.
You are shorter than the last one.

lines.zh: 我抬头，才发现你这么小。
lines.en: I look up and find you so small.
Speak. Do not hide behind your eyes.
This body was made to kill you.
Grip that thing tighter.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，牙比你手指长。
lines.en: My teeth are longer than your fingers.
Hold still. I am not done looking.
Do you understand me?

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人从我背后走过。
lines.en: I dislike people passing behind me.

lines.zh: 这一身硬壳，你的剑砍不开。
lines.en: This shell will turn your blade.
When you have looked enough, kneel.
What are you laughing at? Speak.
That scratched the shell.
I tilt, then steady myself.
It hurts. It does not matter.
You actually found a seam.
Blood runs down my cheek.
I cannot smile, but I am not afraid.
My claws tighten.
I have noted this.
Half a step back, then pounce again.
The shell is cracked. I can still fight.
That would not fill a tooth gap.
Bring more. Pile it up.
So eager. You want to live?
I am not picky, but I need volume.
That thing glows. Give it.
Bring it. I will not ask twice.
That cut is barely enough.
Whatever you hid, I want that too.
A life costs far more than that.
You struck my shell.
Back off. I hate being crowded.

lines.zh: 我的手肘正好在你胸口。
lines.en: My elbow is level with your chest.
That fall was your own doing.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你就在脚边。
lines.en: I look down, and there you are.
Do not touch my tail. You would lose a hand.
Move. I am quicker than I look.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的爪了。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my claw.
Keep crowding and I will grab you.
This face does not suit such a thing.

lines.zh: 我还没有变回原来的样子。
lines.en: I have not returned to my original shape.
This is a time for battle.
I do not wish to discuss this.
This body can barely sit.
Wait until I am restored.
All of it is meaningless.
I dislike soft things.
This is enough.
My claws are too thick for small things.
Two fingers are enough for this weight.
Crushed one. Poor control.
I do not care for things on the ground.
This orb fits well.
My shell creaks as I bend.
Too small to see.
What lies there is mine now.
Do not pick. All of it is mine.
The blast is loaded.
This time I will be thorough.
I pounce low along the ground.
Triple beams, ready.
I have calculated your escape route.
This body is built for the chase.
First I break your legs.
Let us see where you hide.
My claws are spread.
I take this prey myself.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，出卖了你。
lines.en: Your breathing gave you away.
Good. Just this one.
Then let us get to it.
My long face turns slowly.
I hear every breath you take.
Waiting for the best angle.
My fingers open and close.
You reached the wall. One way left.
Ki gathers between my fingers.
Do not turn your back. I dislike it.
Take one more step. Try it.
I want to punch through in one shot.
He is not looking at me. Better.
This close is enough.
The ground is soft. My feet sink.
His shadow is tied to him.
His breathing paused.
This very moment.
My claws rake sideways.
Three beams fire from my fingertips.
I pounce and pin him down.
My teeth sink into a shoulder.
My claws catch his armor.
That flips him over.
The blast hits his chest squarely.
I drive my head forward.
My tail wraps his leg.
He retreats. I follow.
One more rake, then done.
Blood drips from my claws.
That blow was heavier than before.
He blocked it. His hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 这只手刚捏碎一块石头。
lines.en: This hand just crushed a stone.
I slowly pull back and watch.
Third form. Is this enough?

lines.zh: 这一变，连我都觉得陌生。
lines.en: Even I find this change strange.
My long face enters the doorway first.
Who is calling me out there?
New claw marks on the ground.
One more step closer to you all.
Do not back away. It will not help.

lines.zh: 这具身体，我看得见自己。
lines.en: I can see myself in this body.
The transformation is uncomfortable.
Two million one hundred thousand. Enough?
I knocked the doorframe loose.
From today, this is mine.

lines.zh: 身上还带着气功的余温。
lines.en: Ki heat still clings to me.
Look up. See me clearly.
You will remember this face.
My claws are already sharpened.
Fire dances on my shell without getting in.

lines.zh: 我从高处扑下来，差点没稳住。
lines.en: I pounced from a height and nearly lost balance.
Water floods my long mouth. Hateful.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的壳震得发响。
lines.en: The blast makes my shell ring.
The arrow hits my shell and bounces.
This light got into a seam. It hurts.
Just changed, and already hungry.
Current runs the shell; my fingertips numb.
No bottom below. Nothing to grip.
